editorial:
Ever wonder what would happen if a fairy tale turned into a bloodbath? You get a wild ride where Cinderella stops being the victim and starts hunting her tormentors. Instead of a glass slipper and a ball, you get a fairy godmother who is more like a chaotic partner in crime. The vibe is dark but fun, mixing magic with some really gross and satisfying kill scenes. It is not your typical Disney story; it is more like a revenge trip where the underdog finally snaps and takes everything back with a lot of gore.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing with its twists and fast speed. The acting is solid, and the special effects for the kills look great. While some of the plot holes might bother you, it is mostly just a blast to watch. If you are into horror, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a movie night with friends. It is the kind of flick that looks amazing on a big screen, so adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move.
endingExplained: In the final act, Cinderella uses her magic to trap her stepmother and stepsisters in a deadly game. She does not just kill them; she makes them suffer for years of abuse. The big twist is that the fairy godmother is actually a dark entity who feeds on rage. After the bloodbath is over, Cinderella takes over the estate, but she is no longer the sweet girl she used to be. She becomes the new, scary ruler of the house.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark fairy tales and slasher movies.
